# Wooolfmesh

Wooolfmesh is local-first memory for agentic work: a private command center that connects tasks, capture, focus, reviews, lessons, project health, and local knowledge into one execution loop over a Markdown vault.

Wooolfmesh is local-first, Markdown-backed, and preview-first. It is not a cloud-first task manager or a generic AI chatbot. Optional AI requires a configured local or hosted provider; the app remains useful without AI.
